summary: Factory that allocates and initializes a UI widget object from a type id passed in ecx. A switch dispatches to per-type cases: each allocates a fixed size (24, 20, 32 or 44 bytes) with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, installs a per-type vtable pointer from a fixed vtable table, and fills common fields (dword index 1, byte at offset 8, dword index 3). Types 7 and 0x11 run ConstructorVTable3Fields(1, 1) first; type 8 runs SmallStructConstructor_b0e0 first. Returns the constructed object, or null on allocation failure or an unhandled type id.

operations.description: Dispatch on the widget type id held in ecx through the switch jump table; unhandled type ids fall through to the default case and return null.
Allocate the object with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper: size 24 for type 0 (and type 0x11), size 20 for types 1, 2, 6, 7 and 8, size 32 for type 0xD, size 44 for type 0x13.
A null allocation result jumps to the common failure label, which zeroes the result and returns null.
Install the per-type vtable into dword index 0: type 0 stores &off_5AD050, type 1 &off_5AD034, type 2 &off_5AD018, type 6 &off_5ACFFC, type 0xD &off_5ACFA8 and type 0x13 &off_5ACF70.
Set dword index 1 to 2 for type 0 and to 1 for the other simple types.
Set the byte at offset 8 to 1 for the simple types.
Clear dword index 3 to 0 for the simple types.
For type 7, run ConstructorVTable3Fields(1, 1), then install vtable &off_5ACFE0 at dword index 0.
For type 8, run SmallStructConstructor_b0e0 on the object, then install vtable &off_5ACFC4 at dword index 0.
For type 0x11, run ConstructorVTable3Fields(1, 1), then install vtable &off_5ACF8C at dword index 0.
Return the constructed object pointer, or null when the type id was unhandled or an allocation failed.
